speaker: consultant
text: Good afternoon, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Hi Elena, this is Owen Price. We spoke in the free discovery call last week.

speaker: consultant
text: Of course, Owen. The bicycle repair shop. How are you?

text: Great, thanks. I have been thinking about our call all week. The ideas about service plans were brilliant.

speaker: consultant
text: I am happy it was useful. Have you thought about the next step?

text: Yes. I would love to do the Growth Package. But my business partner, Jun, has to agree on any big spending.

text: That makes sense. Nine hundred and fifty dollars is a real investment for a small shop.

text: Exactly. Jun is away until the end of the month, so we can only decide when he is back.

speaker: consultant
text: That is no problem. Would it help if I sent you a short summary of what we discussed, so Jun can read it?

speaker: customer
text: Yes, that would be really helpful.

speaker: consultant
text: I will send it tomorrow. It will include the package details and the payment options.

speaker: customer
text: Thank you. Just so you know, I am personally convinced. I just need Jun on board.

speaker: consultant
text: I understand. When should I follow up with you?

speaker: customer
text: Call me in the first week of next month. We should have an answer by then.

speaker: consultant
text: I will put it in my calendar. Is there anything else I can prepare for Jun?

speaker: customer
text: No, the summary is enough. Thanks again, Elena. That discovery call really opened my eyes.

speaker: consultant
text: My pleasure, Owen. Talk to you next month.
